slots.setting: a snowy mountain ski lodge for cute animals
slots.decorations: Pale pine wood, snowy frosted windows, knitted bunting along the top edge and a small stone fireplace at one side edge of the screen.
slots.background_tones: cozy (cream, pale pine, soft snow white)
slots.kitchen: a cocoa bar hatch with a small knitted curtain
slots.loop_interior: a soft cream sheepskin rug with a faint warm glow from the fireplace
slots.foods: a hot cocoa mug, a cinnamon roll, a waffle, a small bowl of soup or a gingerbread cookie
slots.board_surface: a pale cream knitted rug with a very soft, almost flat knit texture, framed with a thin pine border
slots.obstacles: a pair of short mini skis, a small log stack and a mitten
slots.mood: snug, warm and cheerful, with everyone happily eating
slots.extra_avoid: falling snow over the plates or reservation cards, a dark fireplace wall behind the board
